purpose: Rehearse the Q&A; teach 株主/廃止/流通/各種/合理/要請/中間/命令

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 株主からの質問に備えましょう。
lines.style: proactive assistant organizing the rehearsal, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 廃止する事業について、説明を尽くす。
lines.en: I’ll fully explain the business we’re abolishing.
lines.style: resolved boss committing to transparency, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 流通改革の成果も、数字で示します。
lines.en: I’ll show distribution-reform results with figures.
lines.style: prepared manager backing it with data

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 各種のグラフを用意しました。
lines.en: I prepared all kinds of graphs.
lines.style: thorough assistant noting her work, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 合理性を強調すれば、理解は得られる。
lines.en: Emphasizing the rationale will earn understanding.
lines.style: confident boss outlining the pitch, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 行政からの要請にも触れますか？
lines.en: Shall we mention the government’s requests too?
lines.style: manager checking scope, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 中間目標の達成度も報告します。
lines.en: I’ll report progress on mid-term goals too.
lines.style: assistant adding to the plan, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: では、私の命令として、全員で臨もう。
lines.en: Then, as my order, let’s all face it together.
lines.style: rallying boss issuing the directive, tone holding steady through the whole line
